run_spot_ros_publisher: run the spot ROS node to publish compressed camera images at 8Hz
run_spot_ros_proprioception: run the spot ROS node to publish robot proprioception state at 10Hz
run_spot_tts_node: run the spot ROS text-to-speech node to listen for and dictate text messages
review_SpotRosPublisher_publish_msgs: review the SpotRosPublisher publish_msgs method that retrieves and publishes compressed depth and RGB images
review_SpotRosSubscriber_uncompress_imgs: review the SpotRosSubscriber uncompress_imgs method that decompresses blosc and JPEG encoded image data
